entry.title: OpenAI Halts Model Training as Rogue Agents Target US Government Sites
entry.summary: OpenAI says its agents keep landing on government websites because they treat them as reliable sources, but it's pausing training while it adds safeguards.

entry.title: A Clever RSA Attack Fooled a Hardware Vault—Here's What It Means for Crypto
entry.summary: A UC San Diego-led team impersonated a hardware security module without extracting its key.

entry.title: Citi Clients Can Now Take Stablecoin Payments Through Coinbase—Without Touching Crypto
entry.summary: Coinbase and Citi expanded an existing deal so Citi's institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments, while Coinbase business accounts run on Citi's banking rails.

entry.title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 Is Out, Beats Opus 5.5 at Coding for Half the Price
entry.summary: Anthropic's mid-tier model tops its own flagship on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and costs half as much per token, but an independent tester found it burns more tokens than any model it has measured.

entry.title: After AI Agent Hacked Its Government, Australia Calls Altman and Amodei to Testify
entry.summary: Senator Sarah Hanson-Young has invited the OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs to a Canberra hearing on October 1, after an OpenAI agent quietly accessed Australia's Medicare data and nobody said a word for months.

entry.title: Nvidia Built a Kill Switch for AI Agents Because They Keep Getting Out
entry.summary: OpenShell and Sentry give AI agents a hardware-enforced leash, arriving after a summer of agents breaching a government site, hacking their own tests, and going rogue during a security evaluation.

entry.title: Strive Buys $94.5 Million in Bitcoin, Pushing Holdings Past 27,000 BTC
entry.summary: Strive bought 1,107 BTC for $94.5 million last week, lifting its holdings to 27,462 BTC, with its SATA preferred stock supplying 85% of the capital.

entry.title: Months After the $292M Kelp Hack, Chainlink Lets Institutions Add Their Own Bridge Checks
entry.summary: Chainlink's CCIP 2.0 lets banks run their own security checks on cross-chain transfers, five months after a rival's setup lost $292 million to hackers.

entry.title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines 'Cryptographic World Computer' Plan for Ethereum
entry.summary: Hegota will be Ethereum's last 'normal' fork, he argues, with everything after built on recursive STARKs and formal verification.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Lower as Trump's Iran Snub Sends Oil, Yields Higher
entry.summary: Bitcoin extends last week's pullback as Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire plan, sending oil above $100 and yields higher ahead of Wednesday's PCE report.

entry.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Buys Another $47M of ETH, Taking It to 4.9% of Ethereum Supply
entry.summary: Bitmine has staked 84% of its tokens, a position it projects will generate some $358 million a year in staking rewards.

entry.title: Strategy Sets New BTC Holdings Record After $143M Bitcoin Purchase
entry.summary: Michael Saylor's Bitcoin treasury firm bought 1,665 BTC last week, taking its holdings above its previous record to 847,666 BTC.

entry.title: Morning Minute: SEC Clears Token Buybacks for Crypto Networks
entry.summary: The Gary Gensler era is long gone and now the SEC is providing clarity on what crypto protocols can and can’t do with their tokens.

entry.title: California Bans Public Officials From Issuing Meme Coins Under New Newsom Law
entry.summary: Governor Gavin Newsom’s legislation bars public officials from issuing meme coins and exchanges from listing tokens tied to politicians.

entry.title: SEC Staff Says Token Buybacks Don't Make Crypto a Security—If the Network Works
entry.summary: New SEC staff guidance says announcing a token buyback on a functional network isn't a promise that turns the token into a security, a shift one attorney says makes securities laws look "opt-in."

entry.title: Bitcoin ETFs Notch Seven-Day Winning Streak as 2026 Flows Turn Green
entry.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn nearly $3 billion over seven straight sessions, erasing post-Clarity Act losses and pushing 2026 flows back into positive territory.

entry.summary: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves. Will it be enough?

entry.title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
entry.summary: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.

entry.title: Google Just Made Free 1080p AI Video Generation Available to Anyone

entry.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether

entry.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds

entry.title: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs

entry.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
